summary: Verified end-to-end driver document uploads (4 images: profile, van, licence, insurance) across backend and frontend. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass. Frontend: /driver/signup validates 4 required images (empty submit + no-image submit both show correct errors), full signup flow creates driver → uploads → /driver/documents → navigates to /driver with pending banner. Admin Drivers tab shows 4/4 docs badge and email is visible/searchable. DocumentsUploader in Driver Hub → Settings now includes the Van photo field.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1194 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, admin, driver, bookings) for maintainability.

POST /api/driver/documents accepts any subset of the 4 photo fields; no MIME/size validation on the referenced paths (validation happens in /upload). Fine, but the endpoint could optionally verify paths belong to the caller.

DriverSignup.jsx: if the account is created but a subsequent /upload fails, user is left in a partial state (toast warns to re-upload in Settings). Reasonable UX; consider adding a retry action inline.

Backend endpoints exercised: POST /api/auth/driver-register (creates driver_profile with profile_photo/van_photo/licence_photo/insurance_photo all null), POST /api/upload (auth-gated, returns {path}), POST /api/driver/documents (persists any subset of the 4 keys), GET /api/driver/profile (reflects paths), GET /api/admin/drivers (returns joined email + all 4 photo fields). Frontend testids in use: driver-signup-form, driver-signup-error, ds-file-profile/van/licence/insurance, ds-submit, docs-<user_id>, driver-email-<user_id>, driver-search, documents-uploader.
